correctness.rationale: Logit conjugacy g_{a,b}(y)=y+a/(1+e^y)-ab checked against recurrence. For 0<a≤8, s_a derivative 1-(a/4)sech²(y/2) lies in [-1,1) and equal -1 at only one point, so any two distinct finite logit states strictly approach. Compactness plus return-map tails produces unique m-cycle and global convergence; derivative product gives exponential phases except centered a=8. Uniformly interior forcing produces absorbing compact interval and synchronization. At a=8,b=1/2, odd normal form -y+y³/6 yields inverse-square growth n/3 and sqrt(n)|y|→sqrt3. Sum of logit increments proves calibration. Independent diagnostic fixed-point iterations at a=7.9,8 with periodic forcing and 150000 critical steps gave sqrt(n)|y|≈1.73199658 versus sqrt3; finite tests not an all-input proof.
